headline: Financial Dispute Problems? OJK-BI Expand Settlement Channels
summary: Indonesia's OJK and central bank BI are expanding the LAPS SJK financial dispute resolution service to cover the payment system industry, strengthening consumer protection.
why: The central bank and financial regulator shape how consumer complaints against banks and payment providers are resolved, which affects industry compliance costs and trust.
original_headline: Punya Masalah Sengketa Keuangan? OJK-BI Perluas Jalur Penyelesaian
